title: Flight Insight
description: A flight analysis dashboard that visualizes price trends by country and month to find the best travel deals.
overviewDesc: A travel decision-making tool designed to help you quickly identify the most affordable destinations. By consolidating fragmented price data into a unified dashboard, it allows you to visualize trends by country and month. It eliminates the friction of manual searching, helping users intuitively discover the most economical travel plans through a clean, minimalist UI.

highlights.title: Problem-First UX Design
highlights.desc: Addressed the friction of comparing prices across countries and identifying monthly lows. Designed a comparison-focused interface that eliminates the distractions found on traditional booking sites.

highlights.title: SaaS-Style Minimalist UI
highlights.desc: Inspired by Linear and Stripe, built a UI that prioritizes visual clarity and ease of use — a polished, tool-like layout that anyone can navigate intuitively.

highlights.title: Country & Month Data Visualization Engine
highlights.desc: Implemented logic to aggregate and calculate flight price trends by country and month. Created a unified view that lets users instantly identify the most budget-friendly destinations.
